title: Check CPU and hardware temperatures
summary: Use the `sensors` command to see current temperature readings from your CPU and other hardware components. This helps you check if your computer is overheating.

steps.explain: Run the sensors command to display current readings from all detected sensor chips.
steps.expect: A list of sensor chips (like coretemp-isa-0000) with their current temperature readings in degrees Celsius.

steps.explain: If you prefer Fahrenheit, add the --fahrenheit flag.

alternatives.explain: Show readings in JSON format for easier parsing or scripting.
Show raw sensor output, useful for debugging.
